crossRefs.note: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to…
At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;
It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and…
Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping…
You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also…

translations.web: “You shall tell him, Yahweh says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.
translations.bsb: Thus Jeremiah was to say to Baruch: “This is what the LORD says: Throughout the land I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted.
translations.kjv: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
translations.asv: Thus shalt thou say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.
